ridglan.march_sentence: Held in the Dane County Jail for approximately two nights after the March 15, 2026 open rescue; released March 17, 2026 — contemporary coverage identifies him among the final five people released that day — without formal charges being filed at that time. The felony counts came the following month and are carried on the second case.
ridglan.april_sentence: Arrested April 18, 2026 — the Dane County Sheriff confirms the arrest — on the four felony counts filed over the March rescue, and held approximately three days. Bond of $10,000 cash was set on the afternoon of April 21, 2026, and a contemporaneous update announced that he, Dean Wyrzykowski and Michelle Lunsky were being released on their bonds, apparently during the evening after his initial appearance.
ridglan.append: He was jailed twice: held in the Dane County Jail from March 15 to March 17, 2026 after the rescue itself, released without formal charges being filed at that time, and again from April 18 to April 21, 2026 on the felony counts, until release on the $10,000 cash bond.

saldana.sentence:
Arrested shortly after 2:10 a.m. on April 16, 2026 and booked into the Turner Guilford Knight Correctional Center shortly after 4:15 a.m. — the Miami-Dade booking information establishes both times. Bond of $5,000 was set the same day by Judge Mindy S. Glazer. FIU student journalism reported on April 20, 2026 that she had been released on bond; the exact jail-discharge timestamp is not established in the available reporting, so the release is entered at approximate precision. She faces years in prison if convicted.

Verdict as recorded: No — pending trial, Miami-Dade County
